\begin{document}
Note that $\zeta$ here is not the Riemann zeta function: it is the spectral zeta function
of the oscillator, $\zeta(s)=\sum_{n\ge 0}(n+\tfrac12)^{-s}$, in units $\hbar\omega = 1$.
Its values at even integers follow from the Bernoulli numbers,
\begin{equation}
\zeta(2) = \frac{\pi^2}{2} ,
\label{eq:z2}
\end{equation}
\begin{equation}
\zeta(4) = \frac{\pi^4}{90} .
\label{eq:z4}
\end{equation}
